title: Strain in neurosurgery
summary: We aim at depicting the extent of posttraumatic stress disorder and its precursors in a cohort of medical staff in German neurosurgery.  We want to shed light on the question of whether surgical complications or other stressful situations in everyday work have an impact on the mental health of the medical group.

interventions.name: This is a survey of doctors working in neurosurgery in Germany. Standardized questions are asked to evaluate post-traumatic stress as well as questions specific to the profession and individual characteristics (e.g. age, gender, professional position, etc.).
